title: FH-2 vs shallow skiffs
reason: FH-2 depth (~51mm) exceeds Make Noise skiff rail clearance (~38mm). Not a neighbor issue — a case-depth issue demonstrated via structured numbers.
sourceNote: Seeded from published depth specs; demo KB may contradict store prose.

title: Blck_Noir + arbhar power stack
reason: Combined +12V draw (~390mA) plus other modules can exhaust a skiff PSU quickly. Prefer cases with ≥1.5A +12.

title: Multi-FX 1U depth vs Noise Tools 1U crowding
reason: Both are 22HP 1U; Multi-FX is deeper. In short 1U trays they compete for rear clearance near ribbon cables.
